name: gem-grotto
description: The Gem Grotto (gem_grotto, gem_grotto_2), "the Split Geode", rebuilt from scratch for ROADMAP 49 (tools/blueprints/briefs/gem_grotto.md, REBUILD.md). MC_BUILDER = the minecraft-builder skill's folder. Until the critic says SHIP, 'build' writes candidates.

scripts.build: node "$MC_BUILDER/scripts/run-build.mjs" recipe.mjs --out-dir out --data-version 3955 && python3 ../../rebuild.py gem_grotto gem_grotto --candidate --nbt out/gem-grotto.nbt && LEVEL=2 node "$MC_BUILDER/scripts/run-build.mjs" recipe.mjs --out-dir out --data-version 3955 && python3 ../../rebuild.py gem_grotto gem_grotto_2 --candidate --nbt out/gem-grotto-2.nbt
